## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in BRACE.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran focused tests for this change.
- [ ] I ran `npm run verify`.
- [ ] I ran `npm run license:audit` if dependencies changed.
- [ ] Electron behavior was tested on each affected platform.

## Privacy and security

- [ ] I used only synthetic or fully redacted fixtures and screenshots.
- [ ] I did not add databases, exports, backups, credentials, logs, or absolute home-directory paths.
- [ ] Filesystem, IPC, MCP, provider, and skill permission changes are documented and narrowly scoped.
- [ ] I ran the privacy/secret scanner (`npm test`, including `privacy-scan.test.js`).

## Documentation

- [ ] User, contributor, and release documentation is updated where needed.
